Annotated Chat history: 

Executive Summary 

In this assignment, I interactively used Mistral to complete two coding TODOs. Overall, Mistral demonstrated strong pattern-matching and code-generation abilities, but also showed limitations in faithfully following constrained instructions.

For the first TODO, I explicitly instructed Mistral to fill only the missing code while keeping the rest of the solution unchanged. Mistral performed this task well: it inserted the correct code block, respected the constraints, and provided a short explanation. 

For the second TODO, the assignment required modifying only the faster optimizer’s learning rate to improve convergence speed. Despite emphasizing this constraint, Mistral initially violated it by changing both the GD and GDM learning rates. This indicates a tendency to “over-correct” or apply symmetrical changes even when the prompt imposes an asymmetrical constraint. After I provided a clarifying follow-up hint, Mistral produced the correct answer.

Overall Observations

Mistral performs reliably on well-specified code-completion tasks, but struggles when instructions require fine-grained constraint adherence. Human intervention—especially clarifications or corrective hints—is essential to steer the model toward assignment-compliant solutions.
